source.original_text:
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. The following literal constructions are made for all y,r∈E and initial phases z₀∈E×E; the existential process witness below is global in these parameters. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. 
Write T_j(w)=a for a live record R_j(ε(w))=live(a,z), and T_j(w)=∞ for a stopped record. Define I_n(T)={T_n≤T<T_(n+1)}, and the total selector N(T,w)=min{n:w∈I_n(T)} when such an n exists, and 0 otherwise. For n≥0 let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)) and H_n(w)_j=R_j(ε(w)). Write readTime(live(a,z))=a and readTime(stopped)=0. The abstract guard A_n(T) consists of histories all of whose records are live, whose read times are strictly increasing and whose positive-index read times are strictly below T; it does not constrain record0 itself. Actual H_n starts at live(0,z₀). For h∈Hist_n set d_n(T,h)=max{T−readTime(h_n),0}. Define survival(live(a,z),u,e) to mean u<τ_z(max{e,0}); on stopped it is false. Define W(live(a,z),u)=exp(−Λ_z(u)); on stopped W=0. Put C_n(T)={w:H_n(w)∈A_n(T), survival(R_n(ε(w)),d_n(T,H_n(w)),w_n)}.
For a fixed finite T≥0 let Path_T be all functions from [0,T] into E×E, with its coordinate-product sigma algebra. On every history, including unrealizable ones, define Ψ_n(T,h)(s) by starting at z₀ and visiting j=0,…,n in increasing order: a live record (a,z) with a≤s replaces the current value by Φ_(s−a)(z), and an ineligible live or stopped record leaves it unchanged. All elapsed times in this total definition use nonnegative subtraction.
Define Δ_n(T)={t∈ℝ^n:0<t₁<⋯<t_n<T}, and let m_n be the comap of product Lebesgue measure to this subtype, without normalization. For t∈Δ_n(T), put s₀=0,s_i=t_i, z₀ equal to the prescribed initial phase and z_i=S_rΦ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1)). Set K_n(t)_j=live(s_j,z_j), Γ_n(T,t)=Ψ_n(T,K_n(t)), q_n(t)=ofReal(∏_(i=1)^n λ_r(Φ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1)))exp[−Λ_(z_(i−1))(s_i−s_(i−1))]), and ρ_n(T,t)=q_n(t)W(K_n(t)_n,d_n(T,K_n(t))). The literal toNNReal conversions agree with these nonnegative simplex times.
There exists one actual phase representative Z(y,r,z₀,t,w), jointly Borel in all deterministic parameters, finite time and raw input, with the following properties. On every raw covering interval T_n(w)≤s<T_(n+1)(w), if R_n(ε(w))=live(a,z), then Z(s,w)=Φ_(s−a)(z). If no interval covers s, Z(s,w)=z₀. For each fixed parameter tuple, Z(0,w)=z₀ almost surely.

Put R(x,p)=(x,-p), V_y(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), and nu_y=(volume_E.tilted(-V_y)) times stdGaussian(E), in position/momentum order. Here tilted(-V_y) has density ofReal(exp(-V_y(x))/integral exp(-V_y) dx), and stdGaussian is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian. Normalizability is a consequence, not a premise.

Write H=E times E, pi_y=volume_E.tilted(-V_y), gamma=stdGaussian(E), so nu_y=pi_y times gamma. For the same single global actual Z described above, every y,r in E and every finite T>=0, define op_T G(z)=integral G(Z(y,r,z,T,w)) dP(w), a real Bochner integral, and endpoint_T(z,w)=Z(y,r,z,T,w). Then endpoint_T is measurable and its pushforward of nu_y times P is exactly nu_y.
For every pair F,G:H->R of Borel measurable functions and finite real bounds C_F,C_G>=0 with |F(z)|<=C_F and |G(z)|<=C_G for all z, both z->F(z)*op_T G(z) and z->G(R(z))*op_T(F composed R)(z) are integrable against nu_y, and their real integrals are equal. Thus integral F(z)*op_T G(z) dnu_y(z) = integral G(R(z))*op_T(F composed R)(z) dnu_y(z).
All these conclusions use the same Z, existentially chosen before all centers, references, horizons and observables. Products are phase first, clock input second. No process, kernel, finite mass, signed integrability, momentum symmetry or normalizability is a supplied premise. Dimension zero, T=0, vanishing test bounds, zero bounce rates, infinite waits and raw exceptional fallback remain included. Almost-sure initialization stays parameterwise; no uniform all-parameter null set or pointwise reversed path at jumps is asserted.
The phase-invariance conclusion is fixed-time stationarity of the actual output under Gibbs initialization. It does not assert Markov/restart, Chapman-Kolmogorov, an L2 operator/domain identity, identification with a different existential kernel witness, hypocoercivity, implementation accuracy or actual expected oracle costs. Full paper results and actual-input composition remain open.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
    let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
        (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
    let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
    let Hist : ℕ → Type _ := fun n => Fin (n + 1) → Rec
    let readTime : Rec → ℝ := fun r => match r with
      | Sum.inl q => (q.1 : ℝ)
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
    let Δ : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun n T =>
      {t | StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)}
    let Prefix : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Type := fun n T => {t : Fin n → ℝ // t ∈ Δ n T}
    let m : (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Measure (Prefix n T) := fun n T =>
      Measure.comap (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val) (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))
    let zAt : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Fin (n + 1) → (E × E) := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      Fin.induction z₀ (fun i z =>
        S xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc) z))
    let K : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Hist n := fun y xRef z₀ n T t j =>
      Sum.inl (Real.toNNReal ((Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j), zAt y xRef z₀ n T t j)
    let qReal : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → ℝ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      ∏ i : Fin n,
        rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)
          (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)) *
        Real.exp (-Λ y xRef (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)
          (Real.toNNReal (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)))
    let q : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → ℝ≥0∞ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (qReal y xRef z₀ n T t)
    let A : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Hist n) := fun n T =>
      {h | (∀ j, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), h j = Sum.inl a) ∧
        StrictMono (fun j => readTime (h j)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin n, readTime (h i.succ) < (T : ℝ)}
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ w j => (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    let I : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℕ → Set (ℕ → ℝ) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ T n => {w | eventTime y xRef z₀ w n ≤ (T : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
        (T : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ w (n + 1)}
    let N : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ := fun y xRef z₀ T w =>
      if h : ∃ n, w ∈ I y xRef z₀ T n then Nat.find h else 0
    let liveTime : Rec → ℝ≥0 := fun r => r.elim Prod.fst (fun _ => 0)
    let d : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Hist n → ℝ≥0 :=
      fun n T h => T - liveTime (h ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩)
    let survival : E → E → Rec → ℝ≥0 → ℝ → Prop :=
      fun y xRef r u e => r.elim
        (fun a => (u : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal e)) (fun _ => False)
    let weight : E → E → Rec → ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef r u => r.elim
        (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 u))) (fun _ => 0)
    let C : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (ℕ → ℝ) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T => {w | history y xRef z₀ n w ∈ A n T ∧
        survival y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n) (d n T (history y xRef z₀ n w)) (w n)}
    let Path : ℝ≥0 → Type _ := fun T => {s : ℝ≥0 // s ≤ T} → E × E
    let Ψ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Hist n → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T h s =>
        Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun z j => (h j).elim
          (fun a => if a.1 ≤ s.val then Φ y xRef ((s.val - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2 else z)
          (fun _ => z)) z₀
    let Γ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t => Ψ y xRef z₀ n T (K y xRef z₀ n T t)
    let ρ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t => q y xRef z₀ n T t *
        weight y xRef ((K y xRef z₀ n T t) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩)
          (d n T (K y xRef z₀ n T t))
    let R : E × E → E × E := fun z => (z.1, -z.2)
    let Vy : E → E → ℝ := fun y x => V x + ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η)
    let nu : E → Measure (E × E) := fun y =>
      ((volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -Vy y x)).prod
        (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E)
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), w ∈ I y xRef z₀ s n →
          record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ s w = Φ y xRef ((s - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n, w ∈ I y xRef z₀ s n) → Z y xRef z₀ s w = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ w ∂P, Z y xRef z₀ 0 w = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ T : ℝ≥0,
        let op : ((E × E) → ℝ) → (E × E) → ℝ :=
          fun G z => ∫ w, G (Z y xRef z T w) ∂P
        let endpoint : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) → E × E :=
          fun a => Z y xRef a.1 T a.2
        MeasurePreserving endpoint ((nu y).prod P) (nu y) ∧
        ∀ F G : (E × E) → ℝ, ∀ C_F C_G : ℝ,
          Measurable F → Measurable G → 0 ≤ C_F → 0 ≤ C_G →
          (∀ z, |F z| ≤ C_F) → (∀ z, |G z| ≤ C_G) →
          Integrable (fun z => F z * op G z) (nu y) ∧
          Integrable (fun z => G (R z) * op (fun a => F (R a)) z) (nu y) ∧
          (∫ z, F z * op G z ∂nu y) =
            ∫ z, G (R z) * op (fun a => F (R a)) z ∂nu y)
decoder_context: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space with canonical volume, including rank zero; genuine second Frechet derivative and real Hilbert gradient.
Fin n is zero-based; Fin.cons prepends; Fin.induction constructs a finite sequence; Fin.foldl visits ascending indices. Sum.inl represents a live time/state record; Unit represents a stopped record.

Real division by zero is zero; Real.toNNReal is positive part; nonnegative subtraction is truncated. ENNReal.ofReal embeds the positive part in extended nonnegative reals. Interval integrals use real Lebesgue measure.

Measure.tilted mu h is mu.withDensity(x -> ofReal(exp(h(x))/integral exp(h) dmu)). stdGaussian E is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian. Measure.comap along a measurable subtype inclusion is the induced subtype measure. Products use the displayed coordinate order.

MeasurePreserving f mu nu states Measurable f and Measure.map f mu = nu. withDensity multiplies the base measure by the given extended-nonnegative density. Measure.sum is the countable sum of the displayed measures. IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. All literal let bindings are definitions, not hypotheses.

hittingAfter f D 0 a is the infimum of nonnegative times t at which f t a lies in D, in WithTop nonnegative reals; the empty infimum is top. untopD 0 returns the finite value when not top and zero otherwise.

Measure.infinitePi constructs the displayed countable product law; expMeasure 1 is the unit-rate exponential probability measure on real numbers. The function space carries the coordinate-product measurable structure. A measurable global process and its almost-everywhere initialization are conclusions.

/-- One actual global PBPS process preserves the Gibbs phase law at each fixed time and satisfies bounded signed momentum-flipped duality. -/
theorem actual_bounded_gibbs_duality
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) : actual_bounded_gibbs_duality_statement hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη := by
  classical
  unfold actual_bounded_gibbs_duality_statement
  intro c Φ S rate Λ τ next record P ε history Rec Hist readTime Δ Prefix m zAt K qReal q A eventTime I N liveTime d survival weight C Path Ψ Γ ρ R Vy nu
  obtain ⟨Z, hZm, hZa, hZf, hZ0, h105⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualCountableEndpointLaw.actual_countable_endpoint_law
      hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  refine ⟨Z, hZm, hZa, hZf, hZ0, ?_⟩
  intro y r T op endpoint
  have h103 := AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.ActualPhaseNormalization.actual_phase_gibbs_normalization
    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη y
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (nu y) := by
    have hp := h103.2.2.2.2.2.1
    rw [h103.2.2.2.2.2.2] at hp
    exact hp
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.1
  have hemb : Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) => (((y, r), a.1), T, a.2)) :=
    (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_fst).prodMk (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_snd)
  have he : Measurable endpoint := hZm.comp hemb
  let M : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E) × (E × E) := fun a => (a.1, endpoint a)
  let Q : Measure ((E × E) × (E × E)) := Measure.map M ((nu y).prod P)
  let J : (E × E) × (E × E) → (E × E) × (E × E) := fun a => (R a.2, R a.1)
  have hM : Measurable M := measurable_fst.prodMk he
  have hJ : MeasurePreserving J Q Q := (h105 y r T).2.2
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure Q := (h105 y r T).2.1
  have hRm : Measurable R := by dsimp [R]; fun_prop
  have hneg : Measure.map (fun p : E => -p) (stdGaussian E) = stdGaussian E := by
    simpa using (stdGaussian_map (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ (E := E)))
  have hR : MeasurePreserving R (nu y) (nu y) := by
    refine ⟨hRm, ?_⟩
    change Measure.map (Prod.map id (fun p : E => -p))
      (((volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -Vy y x)).prod (stdGaussian E)) = _
    rw [← Measure.map_prod_map _ _ measurable_id (by fun_prop), hneg, Measure.map_id]
  have hMP : MeasurePreserving M ((nu y).prod P) Q := ⟨hM, rfl⟩
  have hfst : MeasurePreserving Prod.fst Q (nu y) := by
    refine ⟨measurable_fst, ?_⟩
    change Measure.map Prod.fst (Measure.map M ((nu y).prod P)) = nu y
    rw [Measure.map_map measurable_fst hM]
    change Measure.map Prod.fst ((nu y).prod P) = nu y
    simp only [Measure.map_fst_prod, measure_univ, one_smul]
  have hinvariant : MeasurePreserving endpoint ((nu y).prod P) (nu y) := by
    have h := hR.comp ((hfst.comp hJ).comp hMP)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, M, J, R, neg_neg] using h
  refine ⟨hinvariant, ?_⟩
  have htest (F G : (E × E) → ℝ) (CF CG : ℝ)
      (hF : Measurable F) (hG : Measurable G) (hCF : 0 ≤ CF) (hCG : 0 ≤ CG)
      (hFb : ∀ z, |F z| ≤ CF) (hGb : ∀ z, |G z| ≤ CG) :
      Integrable (fun z => F z * op G z) (nu y) ∧
      (∫ z, F z * op G z ∂nu y) = ∫ a, F a.1 * G a.2 ∂Q := by
    let H : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ := fun a => F a.1 * G (endpoint a)
    have hHm : Measurable H := (hF.comp measurable_fst).mul (hG.comp he)
    have hHi : Integrable H ((nu y).prod P) :=
      Integrable.of_bound hHm.aestronglyMeasurable (CF * CG)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a => by
          change |F a.1 * G (endpoint a)| ≤ CF * CG
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (hFb a.1) (hGb (endpoint a)) (abs_nonneg _) hCF)
    have houter : Integrable (fun z => F z * op G z) (nu y) := by
      simpa only [H, endpoint, integral_const_mul] using hHi.integral_prod_left
    refine ⟨houter, ?_⟩
    have hpair : Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) => F a.1 * G a.2) :=
      (hF.comp measurable_fst).mul (hG.comp measurable_snd)
    calc
      (∫ z, F z * op G z ∂nu y) = ∫ a, H a ∂((nu y).prod P) := by
        rw [integral_prod H hHi]
        simp only [H, endpoint, op, integral_const_mul]
      _ = ∫ a, F a.1 * G a.2 ∂Q :=
        (integral_map hM.aemeasurable hpair.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
  intro F G CF CG hF hG hCF hCG hFb hGb
  have hleft := htest F G CF CG hF hG hCF hCG hFb hGb
  have hright := htest (fun z => G (R z)) (fun z => F (R z)) CG CF
    (hG.comp hRm) (hF.comp hRm) hCG hCF (fun z => hGb (R z)) (fun z => hFb (R z))
  refine ⟨hleft.1, hright.1, ?_⟩
  rw [hleft.2, hright.2]
  have hpair : Measurable (fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) => F a.1 * G a.2) :=
    (hF.comp measurable_fst).mul (hG.comp measurable_snd)
  calc
    (∫ a, F a.1 * G a.2 ∂Q) = ∫ a, F (J a).1 * G (J a).2 ∂Q := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hJ.map_eq]
      exact integral_map hJ.measurable.aemeasurable hpair.aestronglyMeasurable
    _ = ∫ a, G (R a.1) * F (R a.2) ∂Q := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a => mul_comm _ _

#print axioms actual_bounded_gibbs_duality
end

Objects and definitions
Fix a finite-dimensional real inner-product space E, with its normed additive group structure and a Borel measurable structure. Its dimension may be zero. Fix V:E→R, nonnegative-real constants alpha,beta, and eta:R. The derivative expression is the genuine second Frechet derivative D(DV)(x), evaluated on v and then on v; gradient V is the real Hilbert gradient.

For y,b in E (b denotes xRef) and a phase point z=(x,v) in E×E, define c(y,b)=y−eta grad V(b) and
Phi(y,b,t,(x,v))=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+sqrt(eta) sin(t)v, −sin(t)/sqrt(eta)(x−c)+cos(t)v).
Define g_b(x)=grad V(x)−grad V(b). Define
S(b,(x,v))=(x,v−[2<v,g_b(x)>/||g_b(x)||²]g_b(x)),
r(b,(x,v))=sqrt(eta) max(0,<v,g_b(x)>),
Lambda(y,b,z,u)=integral from 0 to u of r(b,Phi(y,b,s,z)) ds.
For u,e in the nonnegative reals, tau(y,b,z,e) is the infimum in [0,infinity] of those u with Lambda(y,b,z,u)−e≥0; it is infinity if that set is empty. The flow's time argument is real; Lambda and tau use nonnegative times.

Rec=([0,infinity)×(E×E)) disjoint-union {stopped}. A live record stores an absolute accumulated time and a phase state. Given a threshold e, next(y,b,e,stopped)=stopped. From live(a,z), next is stopped if tau(y,b,z,e)=infinity; otherwise it is live(a+tau,S(b,Phi(y,b,tau,z))). record(y,b,z0,eSeq,0)=live(0,z0), and record(k+1)=next(y,b,eSeq(k),record(k)). Objects and definitions
Fix a finite-dimensional real inner-product space E, with its normed additive group structure and a Borel measurable structure. Its dimension may be zero. Fix V:E→R, nonnegative-real constants alpha,beta, and eta:R. The derivative expression is the genuine second Frechet derivative D(DV)(x), evaluated on v and then on v; gradient V is the real Hilbert gradient.

For y,b in E (b denotes xRef) and a phase point z=(x,v) in E×E, define c(y,b)=y−eta grad V(b) and
Phi(y,b,t,(x,v))=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+sqrt(eta) sin(t)v, −sin(t)/sqrt(eta)(x−c)+cos(t)v).
Define g_b(x)=grad V(x)−grad V(b). Define
S(b,(x,v))=(x,v−[2<v,g_b(x)>/||g_b(x)||²]g_b(x)),
r(b,(x,v))=sqrt(eta) max(0,<v,g_b(x)>),
Lambda(y,b,z,u)=integral from 0 to u of r(b,Phi(y,b,s,z)) ds.
For u,e in the nonnegative reals, tau(y,b,z,e) is the infimum in [0,infinity] of those u with Lambda(y,b,z,u)−e≥0; it is infinity if that set is empty. The flow's time argument is real; Lambda and tau use nonnegative times.

Rec=([0,infinity)×(E×E)) disjoint-union {stopped}. A live record stores an absolute accumulated time and a phase state. Given a threshold e, next(y,b,e,stopped)=stopped. From live(a,z), next is stopped if tau(y,b,z,e)=infinity; otherwise it is live(a+tau,S(b,Phi(y,b,tau,z))). record(y,b,z0,eSeq,0)=live(0,z0), and record(k+1)=next(y,b,eSeq(k),record(k)). Thus n counts n applications of next; the state at a finite event is the post-S state.

P is the countable product on R^N of unit-rate exponential probability measures. For any sequence w:N→R, epsilon(w)(k)=max(w(k),0), interpreted in the nonnegative reals. history(y,b,z0,n,w)(j)=record(y,b,z0,epsilon(w),j), for j=0,...,n. Hist(n) is the full function space {0,...,n}→Rec. readTime(live(a,z))=a as a real, and readTime(stopped)=0.

Delta(n,T) consists of vectors (t1,...,tn) satisfying 0<t1<...<tn<T. In the literal zero-based notation, t_i for i in Fin n corresponds to t_(i+1) in this one-based display. Prefix(n,T) is the subtype of such vectors, and m(n,T) is Lebesgue measure on R^(Fin n) pulled back to that subtype by inclusion. Set t0=0. For t in Prefix(n,T), define z_0=z0 and z_i=S(b,Phi(y,b,t_i−t_(i−1),z_(i−1))) for i=1,...,n. This is zAt. Define K(t)(i)=live(t_i,z_i), i=0,...,n; the displayed Lean definition converts each time through positive part. Define qReal(t)=product over i=1,...,n of [r(b,Phi(y,b,t_i−t_(i−1),z_(i−1))) exp(−Lambda(y,b,z_(i−1),t_i−t_(i−1)))]. The exact expression passes each interval to Lambda through Real.toNNReal. Define q(t)=ENNReal.ofReal(qReal(t)). There is no terminal survival factor in q itself.

A(n,T) is the subset of Hist(n) in which every record is live, the entire sequence of readTime values is strictly increasing, and all times at indices 1,...,n are strictly less than T. For arbitrary members of A, the first time is not separately required to equal zero. Define eventTime(j) as the stored time of record(j), viewed in [0,infinity], or infinity if it is stopped. I(y,b,z0,T,n) is the set of w with eventTime(n)≤T<eventTime(n+1). Define N(y,b,z0,T,w) as the least n satisfying this condition, if one exists, and zero otherwise.

liveTime(live(a,z))=a and liveTime(stopped)=0. Set d(n,T,h)=T−liveTime(h(n)), with nonnegative subtraction (hence truncation at zero). survival(y,b,live(a,z),u,e) means u<tau(y,b,z,max(e,0)); it is false for stopped. weight(y,b,live(a,z),u)=ENNReal.ofReal(exp(−Lambda(y,b,z,u))); it is zero for stopped. C(y,b,z0,n,T) consists of w whose history belongs to A(n,T) and whose next threshold w(n) satisfies survival for record(n) for the remaining duration d(n,T,history).

Path(T) is the type of all functions [0,T]→E×E, where [0,T] is a subtype of the nonnegative reals. For an arbitrary h in Hist(n), Psi(y,b,z0,n,T,h)(s) starts at z0 and visits indices 0,...,n in ascending order. A stopped record does nothing. A live(a,z) record with a≤s overwrites the current result by Phi(y,b,s−a,z); a later eligible index overwrites an earlier one. Subtraction here is nonnegative subtraction. Gamma(t)=Psi(K(t)). rho(t)=q(t) times weight at K(t)(n) for duration d(n,T,K(t)). These are literal definitions, rather than an asserted path-density theorem.

R(x,v)=(x,−v). Vy(y,x)=V(x)+||x−y||²/(2 eta). Let J(y)=integral_E exp(−Vy(y,x)) dx. The first marginal of nu(y) is the measure with Lebesgue density ENNReal.ofReal(exp(−Vy(y,x))/J(y)), using the exact normalized tilted-measure convention supplied in the packet. nu(y) is this measure times the centered identity-covariance Gaussian on E in the velocity coordinate. No extra normalizing symbol is quantified as data.

Domains
E is a real finite-dimensional inner-product Borel space, with canonical volume. Phase states are ordered pairs (position,velocity) in E×E. V is real-valued. alpha,beta belong to R≥0; eta belongs to R. y and b range independently over all E, and initial states z0 range over all E×E. The deterministic flow accepts all real times. Thresholds, stored event times, horizons, and process evaluation times are nonnegative reals; event times may additionally be infinity through WithTop R≥0. Indices n,k are natural numbers including zero. Noise samples are all real sequences, with the coordinate-product measurable structure and probability measure P. Histories have n+1 entries; prefix vectors have n entries. q,weight,rho are extended nonnegative-real-valued; rate,Lambda,qReal are real-valued. F,G are real-valued phase-space functions; their bounds C_F,C_G are real numbers. Z returns a phase point, not a measure or a path-space element.

Hypotheses
The ambient typeclass hypotheses are NormedAddCommGroup E, InnerProductSpace R E, FiniteDimensional R E, MeasurableSpace E, and BorelSpace E. The analytic hypotheses are: (1) alpha>0 after coercion to R; (2) alpha≤beta in the nonnegative reals; (3) V is ContDiff R 2, meaning twice continuously Frechet differentiable; (4) for every x,v in E, alpha||v||²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤beta||v||²; (5) eta>0; (6) beta eta≤1. Clause 1 is joint measurability in all five inputs. Clause 2 is for every y,b,z0,w,s,n,a and is conditional on membership w∈I(y,b,z0,s,n) and record(n)=live(a). Clause 3 is for every y,b,z0,w,s and is conditional on nonexistence of any such n. Clause 4 reads for every y,b,z0, for P-almost every w, Z(y,b,z0,0,w)=z0; the exceptional null set may depend on y,b,z0. It does not give a common null set for all those inputs. There exists Z as quantified above such that:

(2) Whenever eventTime(n)≤s<eventTime(n+1) and record(n)=live(a,z), one has Z(y,b,z0,s,w)=Phi(y,b,s−a,z), with subtraction performed in nonnegative reals. The rule is asserted for every sample sequence, not only almost surely.

In addition, for every measurable real F,G with the displayed nonnegative finite global bounds, both z↦F(z) Q_T G(z) and z↦G(Rz) Q_T(F∘R)(z) are integrable with respect to nu(y), and
integral F(z) Q_T G(z) dnu(y)(z) = integral G(Rz) Q_T(F∘R)(z) dnu(y)(z).
